scope.coverage: Three provisional Shanghai Main Board, non-financial A-share research subjects only.
excluded_interpretations: No Shenzhen or Beijing Stock Exchange coverage claim.
No backtest, paper rule, valuation conclusion, liquidity certification, or strategy admission.

relationship_to_existing_work.c24: C24 remains the controlling direct-A-share data-rights and point-in-time feasibility boundary.
relationship_to_existing_work.c34: This route does not repair, replace, re-parameterize, or infer a result from C34.

decision.rationale: Official exchange disclosures support a narrow issuer-by-issuer evidence queue. They do not close C24's licensed point-in-time universe, corporate-action, market-data, cost, execution, or independent-reconstruction gaps.

research_questions: Can consumer-brand, channel, price, inventory, cash-conversion, and distribution evidence be reconciled from primary disclosures?
Can accounting-policy changes and period comparability be independently reconciled before any financial-quality or valuation work?
hard_gaps: Cash-flow and dividend-coverage audit not performed.
Governance and negative-evidence review not performed.
As-of market data, liquidity, valuation, and independent review not performed.

research_questions: How do hydrology, generation, tariff, project capital expenditure, and financing translate into cash-flow resilience?
Can the disclosed distribution history be reconciled to cash sources, investment needs, debt, and regulatory conditions without extrapolation?
hard_gaps: Free-cash-flow, debt, and distribution-coverage audit not performed.
Hydrology, tariff, project, related-party, and governance review not performed.
As-of market data, liquidity, valuation, and independent review not performed.

research_questions: How do coal volume/price, transport, power generation, capex, safety, and environmental constraints affect cash-flow durability?
Can cyclical cash generation and disclosed distributions be differentiated from a sustainable cash-flow conclusion?
hard_gaps: Cyclical cash-flow and dividend-coverage audit not performed.
Policy, safety, environmental, capital-allocation, related-party, and governance review not performed.
As-of market data, liquidity, valuation, and independent review not performed.

gate_sequence.name: Scope and security identity
evidence: Listing, suspension, risk-warning, delisting, share-capital and free-float records
gate_sequence.proof: The security is demonstrably inside a disclosed scope at the stated as_of time, with no unprocessed status or mapping ambiguity.
gate_sequence.failure_disposition: Do not enter the comparable research sample; never backfill history from today's list.

gate_sequence.name: Complete statutory disclosure archive
evidence: At least three audited annual reports
Corrections, accounting-policy changes, audit reports, internal-control reports, and material announcements
gate_sequence.proof: Financial statements and material events are traceable by reporting period, first-public availability, document version, and source hash.

gate_sequence.name: Business and operating drivers
gate_sequence.proof: Products/services, volume/price drivers, customers/channels, capacity/projects, competition, and risks have source-specific support.
gate_sequence.failure_disposition: No earnings-driver conclusion from a concept label, media summary, or one operating metric.

gate_sequence.name: Earnings quality and balance sheet
evidence: Revenue-recognition, inventory, receivables, prepayments, impairment, capitalization, and non-recurring items
Debt maturities, restricted cash, off-balance-sheet commitments, related parties, and audit opinion
gate_sequence.proof: Profit, operating cash flow, working capital, one-offs, leverage, and accounting judgments can be reconciled and independently re-extracted.

gate_sequence.name: Dividend and cash-flow coverage
evidence: Implementation notice with record, ex, and payment dates
Historical cash dividends, operating cash flow, capex, debt, and restricted-cash evidence
gate_sequence.proof: Each disclosed distribution can be separated into proposal, approval, implementation, timing, tax, and funding coverage; no extrapolation is used.

gate_sequence.name: Governance, control, and compliance
evidence: Pledge/share-change, related-party, funds-occupation, guarantee, auditor, and internal-control evidence
CSRC/exchange discipline, litigation, and negative-search log
gate_sequence.proof: Control, related-party, audit, minority-protection, and adverse-evidence questions have a dated two-sided search record.

gate_sequence.name: Valuation and disconfirmation
evidence: Same-as_of unadjusted closing price and trading status
Verified total/free-float shares, net debt, contingent liabilities, and non-controlling interests
Comparable-company disclosures, historical valuation definitions, model inputs and sensitivities
Original broker PDFs/official pages or auditable consensus snapshot
gate_sequence.proof: Market capitalization, enterprise value, denominators, comparisons, assumptions, and counter-case can be independently rebuilt.
gate_sequence.failure_disposition: valuation_not_admitted; no target-price or upside/downside conclusion

gate_sequence.name: Liquidity and tradable status
evidence: Written rights to use SSE historical price/turnover/status data
Daily unadjusted price, volume, value, no-trade, suspension, price-limit, and free-float data
Calendar, field dictionary, revision log, coverage report
gate_sequence.proof: A pre-frozen observation window supports reconstruction of turnover distribution, no-trade/suspension days, limits, free float, concentrated ownership, and status exceptions.
gate_sequence.failure_disposition: liquidity_unverified; this artifact fixes no threshold

gate_sequence.name: Point-in-time and corporate actions
evidence: First-public time and retrieval time for every material document
Cash dividend, rights, issuance, split/consolidation, share-capital, and status-event ledger
gate_sequence.proof: What was available at each as_of moment, and every price/share/event transformation, can be reconstructed from preserved inputs.

gate_sequence.name: Independent review
evidence: Independent re-extraction of key financial numbers
gate_sequence.proof: A reviewer other than the writer rebuilds the core evidence and no S-level or unwaived A-level issue remains.

point_in_time_controls: Preserve first-public time, retrieval time, report period, URL, source hash, and correction/withdrawal chain for every material document.
Do not use a same-session document unless its first-public availability is independently evidenced; otherwise defer usability to the next valid session.
Store raw prices, corporate actions, adjustment factors, and algorithms separately.
Treat trading status independently from a displayed closing price.
Public webpages are evidence locators, not a substitute for licensed historical data, rights, or reproducible delivery.

downgrade_rule: Any missing G0-G9 hard field keeps the issuer at watchlist_only / insufficient_evidence. Do not substitute current lists, adjusted prices, web snippets, or unverified terminal screenshots for the missing evidence.
